STATEMENTOFFACTS Owner is the owner in fee simple title to that certain land with all buildings and improvements thereon as of the date hereof, located in the Borough and County of Kings, in the City and State of NewYork known as Lot 173 in Block 7315on the TaxMap of the City of New York,for the County of Kings (the“Tax Map") and as and by the street address of 2329-2337 Coney Island Avenue, Brooklyn, New York, more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land") and of all buildings, improvements, additions, alterations or replacements presently located thereon (the “Owner Improvements") (the Owner Land, Owner Improvements, and any building that may hereafter be constructed, including the replacement in whole orin part of the Owner Land with the Owner Retained Development Rights and Owner Utilized Development Rights (hereafter defined) in accordance with this Declaration are collectively referred toherein as the“Owner Property"); Developer is the owner in fee simple title to that certain land with all buildings and improvements thereon as of the datehereof, locatedin theBorough and County of Kings,in the City and State of NewYork known as Lot 1 in Block 7315 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,for the County of Kings (the“Tax Map") and as and by the street address of 2317 Coney Island Avenue, Brooklyn, New York, more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Developer Land") and of all buildings, improvements, additions, Developer Land, Developer Improvements, and any building that may hereafter be constructed, including the replacement in whole or in part of the Developer Land with the Retained Development Rights (hereafter defined) in accordance with this Declaration are collectively referred to herein as the“Developer Property"); The Developer Property and the Owner Property have been merged into a single“zoning lot,”" as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution pursuant to that certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") made by and between Developer and ExhibitC.
